_doc: I/L Arch Mage line (spec #319, I2 #321 / I12 #331). All twelve pool skills are defined in skills/il_arch_mage.json; I/L is playable and F/P (212) remains the default because 212 precedes 222 in canonical order. The line's shape is the one Hero's line set (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4): jobs/il_arch_mage.json, skills/il_arch_mage.json. Class-owned balance rows (the AP row and the bot card scores) live in this file's top-level `balance` (merged by DataRepo.load_all), as Hero's do; the tool hub kit is `hub_kit` on the job.

222._starting_skill: tier C: spec #319 D2: every round starts with Cold Beam in active slot 1.
222._mobility_skill: tier C: spec #319 R4: Teleport (2201002) is I/L's manual mobility skill on the skill key, outside both slot tracks; its data moves into this line with I6.
222._skill_pool: tier C: spec #319: the twelve auto-cast actives of the 200/220/221/222 books. Energy Bolt and Magic Claw are F/P's own definitions (one set of data, no copies).
222._weapon_families: tier C: spec #319: the wand and staff families, as F/P; the Magician armour drops by the class bit.
222._creation_weapon: tier C: spec #319: the same Wooden Wand as F/P; wearing it needs only the Magician class bit (reqJob, no level requirement).
222._provenance: tier C: spec #319 (I2 #321): I12 #331 enables I/L after the skill and tooling tickets; F/P stays the default.

hub_kit._fixture: tier C: spec #319 I11: the I/L fixture (tier 2, the F/P kit worn); tool-only.
hub_kit._kit: tier C: spec #319 I11: both Arch Mages wear wands and staves from the same scroll line, so I/L's spare equipment and scroll stacks are F/P's (values duplicated: a kit is read whole, never merged with another job's).

bot._card_scores: Tier C (spec #319, I11 #330): the ten I/L pool skills beyond Energy Bolt and Magic Claw (cold_beam, thunder_bolt, ice_strike, thunder_spear, element_composition_il, ice_demon, ifrit, chain_lightning, blizzard, big_bang_il) score like every other pool skill, new 100 and rank 74, appended to card_scores as one block. Ifrit (a summon) and Blizzard (a ground field) would otherwise fall to the passive score; all twelve pool skills now ship.
